title: Mid-game hurt retreat distance: in mid phase with HP < 35%, keep the existing retreat going until the nearest visible enemy is at least ~120 m before stopping to heal (HURT_RETREAT_FAR_ON)
behaviors: in mid phase (zone shrinking to the 2nd/3rd circle, 240 m then 140 m; 5+ alive) with HP < 35% of max, when the champion's existing retreat ('retreat to cover' or 'retreat') was active on the previous decision and we would otherwise start the stand-still heal, keep running that same retreat (same hide-spot / back-away path, same boost rule) until the nearest visible enemy is at least HURT_RETREAT_FAR_M (120 m) away or none is visible; give up after 3 s without progress; never at t < 10 s or with a supply drop announced/landed or a drop run/ring hold possible; drop run, zone and heal rules otherwise unchanged
source: coord/data/watcher/RANKED.md rule 11 (nearest enemy while HP<35%, mid phase, 119 vs 95 m)
